enabled.label: Enable lyrics
enabled.description: Show synced lyrics on the desktop and in the bar while music plays.

font_size.label: Lyric size
font_size.description: Font size of the active lyric line on the desktop, in pixels.

max_lines.label: Context lines
max_lines.description: How many lyric lines the overlay may show at once, including the active one.

display_mode.label: Display mode
display_mode.description: Karaoke fills the active line as it is sung, Line keeps surrounding lines, Focus shows only one line.

text_align.label: Text alignment
text_align.description: Alignment of the lyric block inside the desktop widget.

show_next_line.label: Show next line
show_next_line.description: Dimly preview the upcoming lyric line below the active one.

hide_on_pause.label: Hide on pause
hide_on_pause.description: Fade the lyrics out 1.5 s after playback pauses and bring them back the moment it resumes.

show_title.label: Show track title
show_title.description: Print the track title and artist above the lyrics.

show_progress.label: Show progress
show_progress.description: Draw a thin playback progress bar and use the karaoke fill for the active line.

sync_offset.label: Sync offset
sync_offset.description: Shift lyric timing in milliseconds; negative values show lines earlier.

filter_mode.label: Source filter
filter_mode.description: Choose which media sources may show lyrics.

custom_domains.label: Extra allowed domains
custom_domains.description: Additional domains treated as valid media sources in whitelist mode.

disabled_domains.label: Blocked domains
disabled_domains.description: Hosts or subdomains that must never trigger lyrics, in either filter mode; ports are ignored.

disabled_players.label: Ignored players
disabled_players.description: MPRIS player identities or bus-name fragments to ignore.

local_lyrics.label: Local lyric files
local_lyrics.description: Use a .lrc or .elrc file next to the playing audio file before asking LRCLIB; word timestamps in it drive the karaoke fill.

cache_enabled.label: Cache lyrics
cache_enabled.description: Store LRCLIB responses in the plugin data directory so repeats work offline.

overlay_enabled.label: Desktop overlay
overlay_enabled.description: Draw the lyrics on a full-screen overlay instead of a placed desktop widget, and move the block between the calm areas of the wallpaper.

overlay_font_size.label: Overlay font size
overlay_font_size.description: Font size of the overlay's active line, in pixels.

overlay_margin.label: Overlay margin
overlay_margin.description: Free space between the overlay text and the screen edge, in pixels.

wallpaper_aware.label: Wallpaper-aware placement
wallpaper_aware.description: Sample the wallpaper once per change and keep the overlay in its calm, empty areas instead of over the subject. Needs ImageMagick or ffmpeg.

wallpaper_order.label: Roaming order
wallpaper_order.description: Order in which the calm wallpaper areas are visited.

bar.tooltip: Desktop Lyrics — click to open the lyrics panel

panel.no_lyrics: No lyrics for this track yet.
